Thomas Eriksen  
Email: thomas.eriksen@adverve.com | Phone: +47 987 654 321 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/thomas-eriksen | Location: Oslo, Norway  

A junior QA engineer at AdVerve Solutions, specializing in adtech platforms. My focus is on ensuring software reliability through structured testing and collaboration with cross-functional teams. I contribute to automation frameworks and API validation, balancing manual and automated workflows to support scalable solutions. My curiosity drives me to refine testing strategies and align them with business goals.  

At AdVerve Solutions, I transitioned from QA intern to Test Engineer Intern, refining my approach to testing. During the QA internship, I supported the validation of ad-serving components by designing test cases for user interface interactions and backend workflows. This involved documenting edge cases and collaborating with developers to resolve defects. As a Test Engineer Intern, I expanded into automation, creating Python scripts to streamline regression testing and integrating Selenium for browser compatibility checks. I also contributed to API testing, verifying endpoints for ad campaign data integrity using Postman and custom scripts. My work has reduced manual testing hours by approximately 20% in targeted modules.  

Norwegian University of Science and Technology | Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | 2023  
Focused on software design principles and algorithms, with coursework in distributed systems and data structures. My thesis explored automated test generation for microservices, laying groundwork for my current role in test automation.  

Technical Skills  
- **API testing**: Developed Python scripts to validate ad campaign endpoints, ensuring data consistency across platforms. Collaborated with backend teams to debug issues in real-time.  
- **Python**: Automated repetitive test tasks, including generating test data and parsing logs. Used libraries like requests and Pytest for integration testing.  
- **Selenium/Playwright**: Built browser automation scripts to test ad-rendering pipelines, ensuring cross-browser compatibility. Integrated Playwright into CI/CD pipelines for faster feedback loops.  
- **Test automation**: Streamlined regression suites by replacing manual steps with scripted validations, improving test coverage for key ad delivery workflows.  
- **GitLab CI**: Configured pipelines for automated testing, triggering builds on code pushes and scheduling nightly regression runs.  
- **Integration testing**: Validated interactions between ad servers and third-party analytics tools, identifying latency issues in real-time data processing.  
- **BDD/TDD**: Experimented with Gherkin syntax to outline acceptance criteria, aligning tests with business requirements.  
- **REST API design**: Assisted in refining endpoint structures for ad management tools, ensuring clear documentation for developers.  
- **Unit testing**: Wrote Java-based test cases for utility classes, ensuring robustness in data validation logic.  

Projects  
- **Ad Campaign Validator**: Developed a Python tool to automate ad metadata checks, reducing manual verification time by 30% for high-volume campaigns.  
- **Cross-Browser Test Suite**: Built a Selenium framework to test ad rendering across Chrome, Firefox, and Safari, addressing inconsistencies in layout and performance.  
- **API Monitoring Dashboard**: Created a dashboard using Python and Grafana to track API response times and error rates, providing actionable insights for optimization.  

Languages  
- English (fluent)  
- Norwegian (native)
